And you can test it in the Demo where it is now added to the main menu and level 3.   [/p][p][/p][p]Let me know what you think! More updates in the mini devlog video. notes.title: Why I use Proton and only support the Steam Deck
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone! Thank you all for the great support the past weeks while I was on holiday! The most asked questions on different sites are about why I am using Proton and why I, at the moment, am only making this game for the Steam Deck. I talk about it in this new mini devlog where I explain why I made these choices, but in short it is the following reply I wrote earlier:

[b][i]I am a Windows programmer by trade and with proton it just works on the Steam Deck. Why not use it if it works?  

Also with handheld gaming becoming more popular and also Windows aiming for it I might want to make it available for those in the future. Maintaining only one branch is in that sense way easier.  

Sure the game can already be played on other devices now, but I cannot guarantee how it will run on different hardware. 

That is why I only support the Steam Deck as a device to play Game With Balls on :)[/i][/b] [/p]


[previewyoutube="P4uaBxEQxxA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][p]

My [url="https://discord.com/invite/A86Hv9vDSq"]Discord server[/url] is now also updated for my game development projects and other things! Join the conversation there or in the discussion page on Steam. 

Thank you all and see you soon!

notes.title: Gyro through a collection of handcrafted mazes in the Steam Deck exclusive Game With Balls
notes.notes:
The second game from Geert Verhoeff that's only meant to be played on a Steam Deck is Game With Balls, a collection of handcrafted mazes to gyro through.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/gyro-through-a-collection-of-handcrafted-mazes-in-the-steam-deck-exclusive-game-with-balls/

notes.title: The demo of Game With Balls is here!
notes.notes:
[p]It is here! The demo of Game With Balls is now available with 5 different levels! Ofcourse it is just a demo and you can expect way more in the full game when I finish it. At least 40 handcrafted levels and 10 challenges, but there are also some extra ideas floating around. 

This is just the first demo as just before Steam Next Fest I will upload some extra levels for you to try out!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831430"][/dynamiclink]  The demo has been tested many times by me and others, but if you find any problems please let me know in the discussions of the demo on Steam.   [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for the support I have received already! [/p][p][/p][p] - Geert[/p]
